text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Cheers ring out for Narita Brian as she defeats the Assassin and wins the spring Tenno Sho. Rice Shower, amidst the cheers for her foe, stands proud despite the loss.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once again, Narita Brian is moved by Rice Shower's strength of heart and vows to get even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to reach the top, Narita Brian focuses on the first race of the Senior Autumn Triple Crown—the autumn Tenno Sho.
